label: prf:categorical-connection-exists
title: Proof of existence of categorical connections
html:
Proof. Proof of existence of categorical connections

Witness: the trivial connection \nabla_0 = d, where d is the de Rham differential of the Kähler module \Omega^1(A). The Leibniz rule d(ab) = (da)b + a(db) is part of the differential- calculus axiom of the QU.
